thesis: CDNA is in a strong, fundamentally backed uptrend that has held up while the Nasdaq complex sells off. An earnings gap on 2026-10-30 was followed by a higher-low pullback and a rebound, so the post-earnings structure is intact. Revenue is growing at a high rate, free cash flow is strongly positive, cash far exceeds debt and dilution risk is low. The entry zone waits for a small dip instead of chasing, with a defined stop below the higher low. This is a tactical, small-size long and not a high-conviction one: the regime is risk-off, valuation is rich, the news feed was down and the reward/risk is only moderate.
